description: This file defines the ITransactionAgent interface for transaction management within the Orleans framework, including methods to start, resolve, and abort transactions. It is intended for use by silos and activations to interact with the transaction system.
external_methods: Task<(TransactionalStatus Status, Exception exception)> Resolve(TransactionInfo transactionInfo)

classes.name: ITransactionAgent
classes.description: Interface for transaction management in Orleans, enabling start, resolve, and abort operations on transactions.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a new transaction with specified read-only status and timeout.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the specified transaction, either committing or aborting it.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the specified transaction without exception.
